title: Sodium-Ion BESS Commercialization
question: Has sodium-ion stationary storage crossed from product and production claims into a procurable, delivered, commissioned technology with public field-operating evidence?
answer: Product launch and cooperation evidence is supported; a named delivered and commissioned customer system is not established at the stated cutoff.

evidence.title: Sodium-Ion Energy Storage Commercialization State Map: CATL record dated 2021-07-29
evidence.supports: Sodium-ion technology and a planned industrial-chain target were publicly announced.
evidence.does_not_establish: Stationary BESS customer delivery, commissioning, or field-operating history.

evidence.title: Sodium-Ion Energy Storage Commercialization State Map: CATL record dated 2025-04-21
evidence.supports: Naxtra sodium-ion products were publicly launched with manufacturer-attributed mass-production claims.
evidence.does_not_establish: A delivered or commissioned stationary storage system.

evidence.title: Sodium-Ion Energy Storage Commercialization State Map: CATL and HyperStrong record dated 2026-04-27
evidence.supports: Two counterparties publicly described a three-year 60 GWh sodium-ion energy-storage cooperation agreement.
evidence.does_not_establish: Shipment, customer acceptance, commissioning, grid connection, or operating performance.

evidence.title: Sodium-Ion Energy Storage Commercialization State Map: CATL record dated 2026-06-22
evidence.supports: TENER Sodium was publicly launched as a stationary BESS product and future delivery milestones were stated.
evidence.does_not_establish: Completed customer delivery or a named commissioned customer site as of the knowledge cutoff. The phrase field-validated remains source-attributed.

evidence.title: Sodium-Ion Energy Storage Commercialization State Map: CATL record dated 2026-08-25
evidence.supports: TENER Sodium was publicly showcased and a Brazil market partnership was announced.
evidence.does_not_establish: A named commissioned sodium-ion BESS or public field-performance dataset.

counter_evidence.title: Commissioned-site threshold
counter_evidence.reason: The reviewed record contains plans, launches, and cooperation evidence but no accepted named customer commissioning record.

unknowns: Named customer shipment and acceptance record
Named site commissioning or grid-connection record
Dated operating history tied to that system

search_provenance.boundary: Stationary battery energy storage systems only; vehicle, starter-battery, and solid-state battery claims are excluded.
search_provenance.source_types: Manufacturer and counterparty public records; no independent customer field dataset accepted.

history.why: The frozen v0.1 record separated product and agreement evidence from delivery, commissioning, and operating history.
